items.stem: The volume of drink in a bottle is X ml, where X ~ N(510, 5²). Mohammed says the total of 4 independent values of X has distribution N(2040, 400). Explain the error and give the correct distribution.
items.answer: The variance of the sum of 4 independent values is 4 × 25 = 100, not 4² × 25 (which is for 4X). Correct: N(2040, 100).

items.stem: The length of a rod of type A is X cm and the length of a rod of type B is Y cm, where X ~ N(45, 2²) and Y ~ N(56, 2²) independently. Find P(X + Y > 93).
The length of a rod of type A is X cm and the length of a rod of type B is Y cm, where X ~ N(47, 2²) and Y ~ N(60, 3²) independently. Find the probability that X is greater than Y.

The mass of a randomly chosen man is X kg, with X ~ N(75, 10²); the mass of a randomly chosen woman is Y kg, with Y ~ N(69, 7²). All values are independent. (a) Find the probability that a randomly chosen value of X is greater than a randomly chosen value of Y. (b) Find the probability that 2X differs from X₁ + X₂ by more than 10, where X, X₁ and X₂ are independent values.
X ~ Po(5) and Y ~ Po(1) are independent. Grace says that X − Y ~ Po(4). Explain why this is wrong.
items.answer: X − Y can be negative, which a Poisson variable cannot; and Var(X − Y) = 6 ≠ E(X − Y) = 4.

items.stem: X ~ Po(4). Zara says that 4X ~ Po(16). Explain why this is wrong.
items.answer: 4X takes only multiples of 4, and Var(4X) = 64 ≠ E(4X) = 16; it is X₁ + … + X₄ (independent) that is Po(16).
items.markingKey: B1 only multiples of 4 / variance ≠ mean; B1 sum of independent values is Po [2]
